about.title: Over two decades helping people gain independence on the road
about.text1: Hello! I am Instructor Hélvio. I work in training and refining drivers in Sapiranga/RS and throughout the Vale do Sinos region. Over more than 25 years in the profession, I've realized that the main challenge for learners is not mechanical, but rather the pressure and anxiety caused by impatient teaching methods.
about.text2: That's why I created a humanized, progressive, and welcoming approach. Whether it's overcoming fear on highways and local hills, mastering perfect parallel parking, or passing the Detran/RS test on your first try, my commitment is to guide you safely step-by-step.
about.quote: Driving is not an exclusive gift for a few: it is a skill anyone can build with the right guidance and in good time.
about.subtitleRole: Specialist in Humanized Teaching & Driving Phobia

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your first practical lesson in Sapiranga and region.

items.question: I'm terrified of driving or freeze up thinking about hills and highways. Will this method work for me?
items.answer: Yes! Training for licensed drivers is designed specifically for people facing emotional blocks and anxiety behind the wheel. We start on very quiet streets in Sapiranga and advance at your pace, until you master hill starts and drive safely on highways.

items.question: Are lessons conducted in the driving school car or my own car?
items.answer: You can choose! If you are still feeling unconfident, we start in our official vehicle equipped with dual controls (safety pedals on the instructor's side). Once you feel ready, we can transition to your own car so you get used to your daily routine.

items.question: How does reinforcement work for students taking the Detran/RS practical exam?
items.answer: We focus 100% on criteria evaluated by the Detran/RS examination board: official test route, precision parallel parking with easy references, smooth clutch control without jerks, and timed realistic mock tests.

items.question: How many lessons do I need to take?
items.answer: It depends on your goal and current confidence level. In the first lesson, we perform a practical assessment. For Detran reinforcement, 5 to 8 lessons are usually enough. For students with severe driving anxiety, 10 or more lessons ensure solid and lasting progress.

items.question: Which cities do you serve besides Sapiranga?
items.answer: We serve Sapiranga, Campo Bom, Novo Hamburgo, Nova Hartz, Araricá, Taquara, and neighboring towns in Vale do Sinos. We arrange the starting point according to your convenience.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept Cash (with special conditions), Pix, and Credit Card with easy installment plans for lesson packages.
